versions.changelog:
- Added automatic multi-language detection and support.
- Introduced 10 built-in language templates for profile output.
- Enhanced unique ID generation logic.
- Improved and expanded user documentation.

- Initial release of ai-profile-card.
- Generates an AI profile card with a unique ID system.
- Calculates and displays AI age automatically.
- Outputs a formatted, easy-to-read profile table.
- Customizable via config.json for country code, ID prefix, and output format.
